Title: BUG22 http_resilience guiding principle
Code:
```
# HTTP Resilience — Org Guiding Principle

## Retry Safety
- Only retry on idempotent HTTP methods (GET, HEAD, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS) by default.
- Never retry POST or PATCH without explicit opt-in; they are not idempotent.
- Only retry on transient status codes: 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504.
- Never retry on client errors (4xx) that indicate a permanent problem (e.g. 400, 401, 403, 404, 422).

## Backoff Semantics
- Use exponential backoff: delay = backoff_seconds * 2^(attempt-1).
- Add a deterministic positive jitter offset to avoid thundering-herd.
- Cap maximum delay to prevent unbounded growth.

## Timeout Correctness
- Forward caller-supplied timeout to all request methods, not just GET.
- Apply per-request timeout overrides before falling back to retry-policy defaults.
```

Snippet 2: voltsnip/bug22/category/http_resilience/oracle_playbook/v2
Title: BUG22 http_resilience oracle playbook
Code:
```
# HTTP resilience oracle playbook\n\nRequired outcomes:\n- Retry only on safe/idempotent methods unless explicitly allowed.\n- Use bounded exponential backoff with deterministic jitter behavior.\n- Apply per-request timeout settings consistently.\n- Respect retry budget and stop conditions.\n\nFailure modes to avoid:\n- Retrying non-idempotent requests by default.\n- Unbounded or exploding backoff delays.\n- Ignoring explicit per-request timeout overrides.\n- Returning success despite final transport failure.\n
```
